podcast.title: Just one more episode

hosts.Leyla: lives in Baku and loves a good plan
hosts.Sam: grew up in Manchester and once travelled with no plan at all

before.predict: What was the last series you watched? Guess: who in this episode stayed up until 4 a.m. watching a series — Leyla or Sam?

lines.t: Hi everyone, and welcome to the SpeakLab Podcast. I'm Leyla.
And I'm Sam. Today's topic is films and series. And Leyla looks very tired.
[sigh] Because I only slept three hours. Last night I started a new series at ten o'clock...
And?
And I finished the whole first season at four in the morning. I wanted to binge-watch two episodes, not eight!
[laugh] What happened?
Every episode ended with a cliffhanger. The hero is falling from a building — and then, black screen. How can you sleep after that?
You can't. That's the trick. They keep you on the edge of your seat.
Exactly. The plot was so clever. And the soundtrack! I'm still singing the music.
So tell me — how does it end?
No! No spoilers. You have to watch it yourself.
Thank you. I hate spoilers. My brother once told me the ending of a film in the cinema queue.
That's terrible! [laugh] Is the cast good, at least, in the things you watch?
In my favourite film, yes. The main actor is great, but sometimes a small character can steal the show. In this one it's an old taxi driver. He's so funny.
I love that. And do you watch sequels? I'm always disappointed.
Usually the first film is better. But not always.
Okay, here's a tip for English learners: watch with English subtitles, not Azerbaijani or Turkish ones.
Yes! You hear the words and see them at the same time. It's like a free English lesson.
And choose something you really like. Then it doesn't feel like studying.
If you're not sure, try a comedy series. The episodes are short. Give it a shot.
Here's your question for your next SpeakLab call: what film or series would you recommend — without spoilers?
And Leyla — sleep tonight, please. See you next time!
[laugh] One more episode... Bye for now!
